This small maize plot near my home is where I grow food for my family, so I must take care of it well. I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative like my neighbors do, but not too much because the price is high and the rains have been uncertain. I will also carry manure from my cattle to the plot, and I will plant the improved BH maize seed the extension worker brings, since my local seed has been giving weak harvests. I cannot afford to irrigate or hire many workers, so my children and I will do most of the weeding ourselves, and I will only call one or two neighbors for a few days at planting and harvest.
